courseSummary: A hands-on introduction to Excel for complete beginners. You'll learn to enter and format data, write formulas with the most common functions, and turn a table into a chart.

lessons.title: Your first workbook
objectives: Identify workbooks, worksheets, rows, columns and cells
Navigate a sheet with the keyboard

lessons.title: Entering and formatting data
objectives: Enter text, numbers and dates correctly

lessons.title: Formulas and cell references
objectives: Write a formula that references other cells
Explain the difference between relative and absolute references

lessons.title: SUM, AVERAGE and IF
objectives: Total and average a column with functions
Use IF to label rows that meet a condition

lessons.title: Sort, filter and chart your data
objectives: Create and label a column chart

lessons.title: Course review and final quiz
objectives: Recall the key skills from days 1–3
Apply formulas and formatting to a new small table
